While the world change is active

Mini world change in Tiquanda: {creature:Hunter|Hunters} and {wiki:Dworcs|Dworcs} fight over some sacred grounds in the jungle. Depending on the day, you find at the site a {wiki:Hunter Camp|Hunter Camp} with Hunters and Poachers, or a {wiki:Dworc Camp|Dworc Camp} dominated by Dworcs, and perhaps the boss of the winning clan: {creature:Arthom the Hunter} or {creature:Oodok Witchmaster}.
Hunters and Dworcs are fighting over a camp in the Tiquanda jungle.
The mini world change must be active on your world that day.
Health potions (and antidotes if the Dworcs are dominating)
There is no fixed reward: it is a hunting area with a possible boss ({creature:Arthom the Hunter} or {creature:Oodok Witchmaster})
Read the server messages when you log in: they tell you which side is dominating today.
1. How to tell if it is active
When the world change is active these messages appear. The message also tells you who dominates the camp:
There is a fight between Hunters and Dworcs over the sacred grounds

The camp is near {wiki:Port Hope}. Take a boat to Port Hope (for example, in Edron {npc:Captain Seahorse}: {key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes}, 150 gp; there are also boats from Thais, Venore, Ankrahmun, Darashia and Liberty Bay). You disembark at {npc:Charles}'s boat, at the **west** end of Port Hope.

Leave Port Hope and cross the **Tiquanda** jungle **east** to the sacred grounds disputed by the two sides. The camp is a square area, surrounded by bamboo walls (Hunter Camp) or bamboo fences (Dworc Camp), right **north** of the {wiki:Medusa Tower}.
In the Tiquanda jungle there are creatures that are dangerous for low levels: bring potions.
You find a {wiki:Hunter Camp|Hunter Camp} with {creature:Hunter|Hunters} and {creature:Poacher|Poachers}. The boss {creature:Arthom the Hunter} may also appear.
The Hunters and Poachers attack from a distance.

You find a {wiki:Dworc Camp|Dworc Camp} with {creature:Dworc Fleshhunter|Dworc Fleshhunters}, {creature:Dworc Venomsniper|Dworc Venomsnipers} and {creature:Dworc Voodoomaster|Dworc Voodoomasters}. The boss {creature:Oodok Witchmaster} may also appear.
The Dworcs poison: bring antidotes or the {spell:Cure Poison} spell.
The camp is on the surface: to leave, take the same path through the jungle **west** to Port Hope and take {npc:Charles}'s boat ({key:hi}, name of the city, {key:yes}) to wherever you want.
